watches.name: Modello Uno U1-DRD
watches.description: This new serie is built around a vintage military sensibility, drawing in part from the graphic clarity of Vietnam-era field watch dials. The Inspiration comes through in the longer markers, the reduced layout, and the restrained contrast between matte taupe and matte black. The two palettes are used to emphazise the watches’ instrument-like character: DRD uses taupe for a warmer, dustier expression associated with daytime iads, while NRD shifts matte black to the forefront, giving the collection a darker, more tactical presence inspired by night operations. Across Modello Uno, Modello Tre, and Modello Quattro, including the GMT executions, the collection combines matte dials, old-radium luminous accents, and two-piece quick-release leather straps in sand or oliva tones for a cohesive military-inspired look with decorative stitching that subtly recalls parachute construction, adding texture and character without compromising the clean overall design.

watches.name: Modello Quattro U4S-WMB
watches.description: This new collaboration is built around a shared idea that military codes can feel more personal, refined, and quietly distinctive when reduced to their essential elements. Developed with WM Brown Magazine, the watch reflects a sensibility shaped by tailoring and outdoor living, where utility and elegance coexist naturally. The Modello Quattro U4S-WMB translates that spirit into a slim military watch with a clean, contemporary presence. Its matte dark military green dial sets the tone, pairing printed Arabic numerals at 3, 6, and 9 with warm ivory accents for a look that feels grounded, functional, and subtly nostalgic. The WMB logo is integrated as a discreet signature of the collaboration, reinforcing the watch’s editorial identity without disturbing the balance of the design. Housed in a sandblasted 316L stainless steel case and fitted with a dark military green TPU two-piece quick-release strap, the watch is completed by warm ivory Super-LumiNova® details, cool gray trims, and 300m water resistance, balancing field-driven utility with a more relaxed and refined sense of style.

watches.name: Modello Cinque U5SS-SAB
watches.description: This new pair of references is built around the debut of the new Modello Cinque Super Slim case, a more compact and refined architecture designed to sit naturally on smaller wrists. With a 36mm diameter, a 44.3mm lug-to-lug profile, and a notably slim silhouette, the new case introduces a more fluid and wearable proportion, further refined by a screw-down caseback recessed neatly into the case and sitting flush with its surface. Across both references, the collection pairs this new super slim format with matte fango and matte baby pink dials, matte white details, and a fango suede leather two-piece quick-release strap for a cohesive, understated look. The result is a softer and more versatile expression of the Modello Cinque, where compact proportions, clean surfaces, and tonal balance come together in a watch designed for everyday wear, offering a lighter and more effortless presence on the wrist.

watches.name: Modello Due UT2-TOB
watches.description: These new Modello Due Toolwatch references are built around a return to the origins, arriving ten years after the launch of the first Modello Due and reworking its original dial design through the mechanical and chromatic codes of the Toolwatch line. The familiar layout is brought back with printed Arabic numerals and markers, while the introduction of matte black and olive green, together with UNIMATIC’s distinctive international orange accents, gives the watches a sharper, more field-driven character. The collection combines sandblasted stainless steel cases, matte dials, white open seconds rails, and nylon keeper two-piece straps for a cohesive utilitarian look. The quartz VH31A movement with sweeping seconds reinforces the clean, precise feel of the project, while the black and rust brown strap options further distinguish the two versions without compromising the stripped-back identity of the Modello Due.

watches.name: Modello Uno U1S-NPF
watches.description: The UNIMATIC Modello Uno U1S-NPF , part of the Langhe Collection, is a Made-in-Italy automatic dive watch featuring a satin-finished Fog grey dial and Fumo deer leather strap. Its 40 mm brushed 316L stainless steel case, colour-matched anodized aluminium bezel insert and double-domed sapphire crystal provide 300-metre water resistance . Powered by the Swiss automatic Sellita SW200-1b movement , it offers a minimum 38-hour power reserve. Limited to 200 pieces , it pairs utilitarian dive-watch design with a restrained grey palette.

specsRaw.Countdown Bezel: Marked in reverse, from 60 down to 0, this bezel is designed for timing a set interval. Rotate it so the desired number of minutes (for example, 15) lines up with the minute hand. When the minute hand reaches the 0 marker, the countdown is complete.
specsRaw.GMT Bezel: Featuring a 24-hour scale, the GMT bezel rotates in both directions and works together with your watch's GMT hand to display a second time zone. By adjusting the bezel, you can also track a third time zone.
specsRaw.Compass Bezel: Marked with the cardinal directions, the compass bezel can be used for basic navigation. Point the hour hand toward the sun, then use the bezel's directional markings to determine north and south.
specsRaw.Dive / Elapsed Time Bezel: Marked from 0 to 60 minutes, this bezel rotates only counter-clockwise. Align the triangle (0 marker) with the current position of the minute hand to track the elapsed time at a glance.

watches.name: Modello Cinque U5S-T-ICON-B
watches.description: The Modello Cinque U5S-T-ICON-B , a Made-in-Italy titanium watch , features a deep black dial with engraved UNIMATIC logo, skeletonized hands with Super-LumiNova® BG W9 , and a matte black reverse lollipop seconds hand with luminous tip. Protected by a 2.2 mm double-domed sapphire crystal with inner anti-reflective coating, the watch features a black DLC-coated Grade 2 titanium 36 mm case , measuring 11.6 mm in thickness without the lens. Powered by the Swiss automatic Sellita SW200-1b movement tuned to 28,800 bph, it offers at least 38-hour power reserve , hacking seconds, self-winding, and manual winding. The watch comes on a black suede leather two-piece quick-release strap with matching titanium buckle. The caseback features the Alchemical Sun and individual progressive number. Limited to 99 pieces and covered by a 24-month worldwide warranty , the Modello Cinque U5S-T-ICON-B combines black DLC titanium with a compact, essential design.

watches.description: The Modello Quattro U4-GMT-EMJDM , a Made-in-Italy military GMT watch , features an E. Marinella blue dial with debossed micro-pattern , matte white trims, and Super-LumiNova® BG W9. Time is displayed with E. Marinella blue phantom ladder hands, a reverse lollipop seconds hand, and a matte black GMT hand. Protected by a 2.8 mm flat sapphire crystal with anti-reflective coating, the watch features a brushed 316L stainless steel 40 mm case , 8 mm crown, and fixed monoblock bezel, providing individually tested 300m / 1000 ft / 30 ATM water resistance . Powered by the NH34A automatic GMT movement , it offers more than 41-hour power reserve , hacking seconds, self-winding, manual winding, and dedicated GMT functionality. The watch comes on an E. Marinella blue double-layer nylon two-piece quick-release strap with UNIMATIC embroidery with brushed stainless steel hardware signed UNIMATIC. The caseback features a dedicated E. Marinella ties engraving and individual progressive number. Limited to 100 pieces and covered by a 24-month worldwide warranty , the Modello Quattro U4-GMT-EMJDM brings UNIMATIC’s military design together with E. Marinella’s sartorial heritage.

watches.name: Modello Uno U1-MI
watches.description: The UNIMATIC Modello Uno U1-MI is a Made in Italy automatic dive watch inspired by twelve of the brand’s most sought-after collaborations. Created exclusively for the UNIMATIC flagship store in Milan, this special edition brings together distinctive colors, materials, and design details from landmark UNIMATIC watches in one original timepiece. The twelve-sector dial features individually color-matched details and luminous treatments, creating a distinctive interpretation of the iconic Modello Uno design. Rather than reissuing past collaborations, the U1-MI celebrates UNIMATIC’s history through a completely new watch. Designed as a professional dive watch, the UNIMATIC U1-MI features a 40mm 316L stainless steel case , 300m / 30 ATM water resistance, a 120-click unidirectional safety bezel, and a 2.5mm double-domed sapphire crystal with inner anti-reflective coating. The watch is powered by the reliable automatic NH35A movement, offering more than 41 hours of power reserve, with both automatic and manual winding. Made in Italy and available exclusively in Milan, the Modello Uno U1-MI combines UNIMATIC’s utilitarian design philosophy, Italian craftsmanship, and a unique tribute to the collaborations that have shaped the brand.

specsRaw.Countdown Bezel: Marked in reverse, from 60 down to 0, this bezel is designed for timing a set interval. Rotate it so the desired number of minutes (for example, 15) lines up with the minute hand. When the minute hand reaches the 0 marker, the countdown is complete.
specsRaw.GMT Bezel: Featuring a 24-hour scale, the GMT bezel rotates in both directions and works together with your watch's GMT hand to display a second time zone. By adjusting the bezel, you can also track a third time zone.
specsRaw.Compass Bezel: Marked with the cardinal directions, the compass bezel can be used for basic navigation. Point the hour hand toward the sun, then use the bezel's directional markings to determine north and south.
specsRaw.Dive / Elapsed Time Bezel: Marked from 0 to 60 minutes, this bezel rotates only counter-clockwise. Align the triangle (0 marker) with the current position of the minute hand to track the elapsed time at a glance.

watches.name: Modello Quattro U4S-BRZ-MLL
watches.description: Modello Quattro ref. U4S-BRZ-MLL is a Made in Italy slim minimal military watch in bronze. It features a hand made in Italy bronze-like tapisserie dial with hand-applied Super-LumiNova® GL light old radium. Time is displayed thanks to metallic gold ladder handset and the reverse lollipop second hand with Super-LumiNova® second tip. The flat anti-reflective sapphire crystal provides the best performance in every light condition. The thin bronze case, the screwed-in 2mm thick caseback, the 8mm diameter crown together with the high-quality gaskets set to provide water resistance tested individually to 30 atm=300m=1000ft. Timing accuracy is guaranteed by the automatic calibre Sellita SW200-1 movement tuned to 28,800bph with 38h power reserve and hacking second-hand. It comes on a milk shake distressed leather strap, an extra foliage green TPU two-piece strap with a bronze brushed finish buckle signed Unimatic. The titanium caseback features Unimatic x Massena LAB engraving and the individual progressive number. The watch is covered by a 24-month worldwide warranty and is part of a unique edition of 99 pieces.

watches.name: Modello Quattro UT4-TBB
watches.description: The Modello Quattro Toolwatch UT4-TBB is a Made-in-Italy quartz military watch created in collaboration with Tutto Bene Hillclimb . It features a Patriot Blue Cerakote® case , a matching blue dial with Super-LumiNova® UNILIGHT C1 luminous markers , and contrasting white and orange details. Protected by a flat sapphire crystal with anti-reflective coating , the watch features a sandblasted 316L stainless steel case with individually tested 300m (30 ATM ≈ 1000ft) water resistance . Powered by the VH31A quartz movement , the UT4-TBB comes on a Patriot Blue nylon strap with a matching Cerakote ®-coated stainless steel buckle. Limited to 45 individually numbered pieces , it features a dedicated UNIMATIC x Tutto Bene Hillclimb caseback engraving and comes in a UNIMATIC travel pouch with a 24-month worldwide warranty . *The Modello Uno UT4-TBB has been tested to meet MIL-STD-810 standards , a U.S. military specification that ensures equipment is built and tested for real-world environmental challenges.

watches.name: Modello Uno U1-GMT-AEB
watches.description: The UNIMATIC Modello Uno U1-GMT-AEB is a limited-edition automatic GMT dive watch designed for professional underwater performance. Made in Italy, this 300m water-resistant dive watch features a 40mm brushed 316 stainless steel case, measuring 41.5mm with the bezel, and a 120-click mono-directional security bezel with a matte black 24-hour insert and raised odd-number numerals. The functional matte black dial features Super-LumiNova® C1 , with subtle debossed open seconds rail and dial trims for enhanced legibility. Built for demanding conditions, the 30atm GMT dive watch is equipped with a 2.5mm double-domed sapphire crystal with inner-side anti-reflective coating and a distinctive “wrinkled” caseback. Powered by the automatic NH34A movement , it features a dedicated GMT function, hacking seconds, self-winding and manual winding, with more than 41 hours of power reserve. The UNIMATIC U1-GMT-AEB comes fitted with a black seatbelt NATO strap and includes an additional olive drab seatbelt NATO strap. Limited to 250 individually numbered pieces worldwide, this automatic GMT dive watch is delivered in a UNIMATIC tough case with a warranty card featuring a unique ID seal.

The functional aluminium color dial features a matte white subdial and Super-LumiNova® C1 , with subtle debossed open seconds rail and dial trims for enhanced legibility. Built for demanding conditions, the 30atm chronograph is equipped with a 2.5mm double-domed sapphire crystal with inner-side anti-reflective coating and a distinctive “wrinkled” caseback. Limited to 250 individually numbered pieces worldwide, this meca-quartz chronograph is delivered in a UNIMATIC tough case with a warranty card featuring a unique ID seal.

watches.name: Modello Uno U1-TAB
watches.description: The UNIMATIC Modello Uno ref. U1-TAB is a limited-edition professional diving toolwatch developed in collaboration with legendary Italian marine engineering name Tullio Abbate. Housed in a brushed 316L stainless steel case measuring 40mm (41.5mm with the bezel), it features a 120-click mono-directional safety bezel with a reflex blue aluminum insert bearing the iconic Tullio Abbate number 5. Protected by a 2.5mm double-domed anti-reflective sapphire crystal, the matte white dial with reflex blue trims utilizes Super-LumiNova® GL C3 and reflex blue ladder phantom hands with a matte red tip for maximum legibility. Built for high-performance aquatic environments, it guarantees a 300M water resistance and incorporates UNIMATIC’s signature 8mm Alchemical Sun screw-down crown. Powered by the automatic NH35A caliber , it features hacking seconds and bi-directional automatic winding, with each unit individually tested for accuracy. This exclusive reference offers a highly controlled, sport-driven aesthetic, delivered on a reflex blue TPU quick-release strap alongside an additional cool gray nylon strap with signed hardware. Limited to just 200 individually numbered units worldwide, it comes packaged in a custom UNIMATIC x Tullio Abbate tough case with a unique ID-seal warranty card.

watches.name: Modello Due UT2-NST
watches.description: Engineered for the 2026 Natural Selection global tour, the UNIMATIC Modello Due UT2-NST is a professional-grade, Made in Italy field watch built for extreme sporting environments. This strictly limited edition of 100 pieces features a 38mm sandblasted 316L stainless steel case integrated with an innovative 360° TPU anti-shock system to protect its sweeping-second Seiko VH31A quartz movement from heavy impacts. Designed for peak legibility from the Alaskan backcountry to the ocean, it boasts a matte black dial with Super-LumiNova® GL C1 markers and a 2.7mm double-domed sapphire crystal. Water-resistant to 300m (1000ft) , this rugged toolwatch is delivered with a versatile kit of five nylon straps in various colors, making it the ultimate resilient instrument for snow, dirt, and water.

watches.name: Modello Uno UT1-PD
watches.description: The UNIMATIC Modello Uno UT1-PD is a limited-edition professional dive watch blending rugged MIL-STD-810H military-grade durability with the functional clarity of the Toolwatch line. Built to perform, this 300m water-resistant tactical watch features a 41.5mm sandblasted 316L stainless steel case, a 120-click mono-directional bezel with a matte black countdown insert, and a high-legibility dial with Super-LumiNova® C1 . This robust 30atm toolwatch ensures peak underwater performance, incorporating an anti-reflective flat sapphire crystal and a signature 8mm screw-down crown. Powered by the innovative VH31A quartz movement , this timepiece delivers a mechanical-style sweeping seconds hand and a 2-year battery life. It comes fitted on a durable black TPU rubber strap with brushed hardware and an exclusive Prodiver dive-mask engraved caseback . Limited to just 250 individually numbered pieces worldwide, the UNIMATIC UT1-PD is delivered in a branded tough case with a unique ID-seal warranty card. *The Modello Uno UT1-PD is officially tested to meet rigorous MIL-STD-810H standards for real-world environmental challenges.

watches.name: Modello Tre U3S-T-AA
watches.description: The UNIMATIC x Automobili Amos for Sease Modello Tre U3S-T-AA is a groundbreaking 40mm automatic chronograph crafted in lightweight, sandblasted Grade 2 titanium . Engineered for performance, it features a Sellita SW510 BH b chronometer movement with a 56-hour power reserve and a precision tachymeter scale . The titanium gray dial is protected by a double-domed sapphire crystal and features Super-LumiNova® orange accents for maximum legibility. Built for extreme environments, this 300m water-resistant tool watch includes an 8mm screw-down crown, oversized pushers, and a sapphire exhibition caseback. It comes complete with a safari orange TPU strap and an exclusive Solaro fabric strap with titanium hardware.

specsRaw.UNIMATIC: , Automobili Amos , and SEASE have joined forces to create the Safari Rally Kit . This is more than a collection of products; it is a curated ecosystem designed for the modern “gentleman driver” who seeks the spirit of the 1970s rally era through the lens of contemporary technology.

watches.name: Modello Due U2-GMT-NR-T
watches.description: The Modello Due ref. U2-GMT-NR-T is a GMT field watch with 300 m diving-grade water resistance. It features a one-of-a-kind oxidized copper laser-cut dial with 31 holes around its perimeter displaying the date. It offers a darker interpretation, featuring matte black ladder ghost GMT, hour and minute hands, a reverse lollipop seconds hand, and a GMT hollow arrow tip in dark cool gray, with matching dark cool gray dial trims and open seconds rail. The 2.7 mm thick ultra double-domed anti-reflective sapphire crystal provides optimal performance in all light conditions. The brushed 316 solid stainless steel case, screwed-in caseback, and 8 mm diameter crown, together with a high-quality gasket set, provide water resistance individually tested to 300 m ≈1000 ft ≈ 30 atm. Timing accuracy is ensured by the NH34A automatic movement, tuned to 21,600 bph, with a 41-hour power reserve and hacking seconds hand. It comes with a brushed solid steel bracelet and a green two-piece strap made from up-cycled military tent fabric with top stitching. The caseback features UNIMATIC × Norwegian Rain engraving and an individual progressive number. The watch is covered by a 24-month worldwide warranty. Each dial is laser-cut from galvanised copper and subjected to controlled oxidation, creating a unique patina – no two are the same.

watches.name: Steel Brushed Bracelet
watches.description: The UNIMATIC Brushed Solid Steel Bracelet is designed exclusively for the UNIMATIC® model family, combining Italian craftsmanship, elegance, and durability . Featuring a slim tapered design and a micro-adjustable folding clasp with diver extension , it ensures a precise and comfortable fit, with up to an extra 15 mm adjustment in 2.5 mm increments. Removable screw-in links allow further customization to suit your wrist perfectly. This improved bracelet offers a lighter, slicker feel while maintaining the robustness and style UNIMATIC is known for. It is available in five options to fit the entire range of compatible UNIMATIC watches.

specsRaw.Professional adjustment recommended: Use a flat blade screwdriver (Bergeon 160) and a proper bracelet vice.
specsRaw.Pin handling: After unscrewing the pins, apply a medium-strength thread-locker (Loctite 243) to prevent them from loosening due to vibrations.
specsRaw.Liability notice: UNIMATIC is not responsible for any damage caused by improper use.

watches.name: Modello Cinque U5S-NS
watches.description: Modello Cinque U5S-NS is a Made-in-Italy all-round watch developed in collaboration with Nichetto . It features a cool gray grainé dial with primary shape windows, complemented by gray dial trims and logos, and a distinctive multicolor day wheel for a subtle yet playful visual identity. The dial is framed by an engraved rehaut with 5-minute markers , adding depth and functional clarity. Time is displayed by brushed stainless steel minimal phantom hour and minute hands paired with a matte black reverse lollipop seconds hand. The double-domed 2.2 mm anti-reflective sapphire crystal ensures optimal legibility and performance in every light condition. The slim 11.6 mm solid 316L sandblasted stainless steel case , with screwed-in caseback and 8 mm screw-down Alchemical Sun crown , is individually tested for 30 atm water resistance (≈ 300 m / 1000 ft) . Timing is powered by the automatic Sellita SW200-1 caliber , running at 28,800 bph with a minimum 38-hour (typical 41-hour) power reserve and hacking seconds. The watch comes with a black padded deer leather two-piece quick-release strap with top stitching and curved lugs, secured by sandblasted stainless steel hardware signed UNIMATIC , fitting 22 mm lugs . The caseback features UNIMATIC and Nichetto “Color Wheel” screw-down engraving . The watch is covered by a 24-month worldwide warranty and is part of a limited edition of 30 individually numbered pieces .

watches.name: Modello Cinque UT5-JDM
watches.description: The Modello Cinque UT5-JDM “Concrete Jungle” is a Made-in-Italy quartz all-round watch designed exclusively for the Japanese domestic market. Featuring a matte cool gray dial with Super-LumiNova® GL C1 and dark gray open second rail, it balances utilitarian performance with minimalist style. Time is displayed through dark gray ladder hands and a reverse lollipop second hand with Super-LumiNova® GL C1 tip, ensuring clarity in all conditions. The double-domed sapphire crystal with inner anti-reflective coating guarantees optimal visibility and durability. Its 11.6mm solid 316L sandblasted stainless steel case , screwed-in caseback , and 8mm crown combine with premium gaskets for water resistance tested to 30 atm (300m/1000ft) . The VH31 quartz movement , enhanced by a Made-in-Italy TPU anti-shock system , ensures precision and reliability. The watch comes with a cool gray two-piece nylon quick-release strap with sandblasted hardware signed UNIMATIC, fitting securely within 22mm lugs. The caseback features JDM screw-down engraving , marking its exclusivity. Each piece is part of a limited edition of 50 units , covered by a 24-month worldwide warranty , merging Italian craftsmanship with Japanese exclusivity in a timeless, understated design.

watches.name: Modello Quattro UT4-JDM
watches.description: The UNIMATIC Modello Quattro UT4-JDM is a Made in Italy military quartz watch created exclusively for the Japanese Domestic Market (JDM) . Designed for durability and precision, it features a matte grainé gunmetal dial enhanced with Super-LumiNova® GL Old Radium markers , a cool gray open second rail , and refined dial trims. Time is displayed with phantom ladder hands and a reverse lollipop seconds hand accented by a cool gray tip, reflecting UNIMATIC’s signature minimalist design. Protected by a flat anti-reflective sapphire crystal , the UT4-JDM ensures exceptional legibility under any lighting conditions. Its matte gunmetal PVD-coated 316L stainless steel case , screw-in 2mm thick caseback , 8mm crown , and premium gaskets deliver professional-grade reliability and 300m (30 ATM / 1000ft) water resistance , each unit individually tested for performance. Powered by the VH31 Japanese quartz movement , the UT4-JDM achieves precise timing with a smooth sweeping seconds hand. The movement is housed within a Made-in-Italy TPU 360° anti-shock protection system , ensuring superior impact resistance — a hallmark of UNIMATIC’s toolwatch engineering. The watch is completed with a dark olive nylon two-piece keeper strap , fitted with matte gunmetal PVD-coated stainless steel sandblasted hardware signed UNIMATIC , perfectly integrated into its 22mm lugs . On the caseback, a Japanese Domestic Market screw-down engraving underscores its exclusivity. The UNIMATIC Modello Quattro UT4-JDM comes with a 24-month worldwide warranty , reaffirming the brand’s commitment to quality and precision craftsmanship.

watches.name: Modello Tre U3S-M
watches.description: The Modello Tre ref. U3S-M is a premium Made in Italy automatic chronograph crafted with uncompromising attention to detail. It features a matte black index dial with two off-black concentric subdials, complemented by a matte black stainless-steel bezel insert with a DLC sandblasted finish. Timekeeping is ensured by the matte black ladder skeleton handset and the reverse lollipop seconds hand with an off-black tip. A double-domed, anti-reflective sapphire crystal delivers exceptional visibility in all lighting conditions. The black DLC-coated 316L solid stainless-steel case , complete with a sandblasted finish, screw-down sapphire exhibition caseback, oversized 8 mm crown, and robust 5.5 mm screw-in pushers, guarantees outstanding durability. Each watch is individually tested and certified for 30 ATM (300 m / 1000 ft) water resistance. Inside, the automatic Sellita SW510 BH b movement beats at 28,800 bph and offers a 62-hour power reserve, hacking seconds, a running seconds indicator at 9 o’clock, and a 30-minute counter at 3 o’clock. The watch is paired with a matching black DLC sandblasted stainless-steel bracelet . The exhibition caseback is engraved with Maxfield branding. This model is covered by a 24-month worldwide warranty and released as an ultra-limited edition of only 30 pieces.

watches.name: Modello Tre U3FB-AAS
watches.description: The Modello Tre ref. U3FB-AAS is a Made-in-Italy chrono-diver developed in partnership with Automobili Amos . It features a distinctive dust dial with two subdials and a fixed monoblock bezel engraved with a deep, acid-etched tachymeter for precise speed and timing measurement. Timekeeping is handled by dust ladder phantom hour and minute hands filled with Super-LumiNova® GL dark orange , ensuring strong low-light visibility. The reversed lollipop seconds hand, finished with a safari-orange tip, matches the subdial hands for cohesive visual clarity. A 2.5 mm double-domed sapphire crystal with anti-reflective coating guarantees optimal readability in any lighting environment. specsRaw.Countdown Bezel: Marked in reverse, from 60 down to 0, this bezel is designed for timing a set interval. Rotate it so the desired number of minutes (for example, 15) lines up with the minute hand. When the minute hand reaches the 0 marker, the countdown is complete.
specsRaw.GMT Bezel: Featuring a 24-hour scale, the GMT bezel rotates in both directions and works together with your watch's GMT hand to display a second time zone. By adjusting the bezel, you can also track a third time zone.
specsRaw.Compass Bezel: Marked with the cardinal directions, the compass bezel can be used for basic navigation. Point the hour hand toward the sun, then use the bezel's directional markings to determine north and south.
specsRaw.Dive / Elapsed Time Bezel: Marked from 0 to 60 minutes, this bezel rotates only counter-clockwise. Align the triangle (0 marker) with the current position of the minute hand to track the elapsed time at a glance.

specsRaw.Modello Uno ref. UT1-GO: is the Made in Italy UNIMATIC quartz dive watch . It features matte black bezel insert, glacier white dial with hand-applied 3D UNILIGHT markers, dark gray open second rail and dial trims.
specsRaw.Countdown Bezel: Marked in reverse, from 60 down to 0, this bezel is designed for timing a set interval. Rotate it so the desired number of minutes (for example, 15) lines up with the minute hand. When the minute hand reaches the 0 marker, the countdown is complete.
specsRaw.GMT Bezel: Featuring a 24-hour scale, the GMT bezel rotates in both directions and works together with your watch's GMT hand to display a second time zone. By adjusting the bezel, you can also track a third time zone.
specsRaw.Compass Bezel: Marked with the cardinal directions, the compass bezel can be used for basic navigation. Point the hour hand toward the sun, then use the bezel's directional markings to determine north and south.
specsRaw.Dive / Elapsed Time Bezel: Marked from 0 to 60 minutes, this bezel rotates only counter-clockwise. Align the triangle (0 marker) with the current position of the minute hand to track the elapsed time at a glance.

watches.name: Modello Quattro U4S-BRZ-SI
watches.description: A three-way collaboration, and a pièce unique , U4S-BRZ-SI was conceived and created to celebrate Swiss history and to benefit New York City’s Swiss Institute. The UNIMATIC x King Nerd x Massena LAB U4S-BRZ-SI is a self-winding wristwatch with a bronze case (UNIMATIC’s first ever use of bronze) and a bronze, galvanic-coated and hand-engraved dial by the artist King Nerd. The U4S-BRZ-SI commemorates the story of William Tell, the Swiss folk hero thought to be the originator of the Swiss Confederation. According to legend, William Tell was a famed 14th-century outdoorsman and marksman. When he, quite literally, refused to bow to the Austrian dominion of his Swiss canton, both he and his young son were arrested and sentenced to death. Before the planned execution, in a cruel plot to punish and humiliate Tell even further, Tell was offered a chance at freedom. If, and only if, Tell could, in one attempt, shoot an arrow through an apple placed on top of his blindfolded son’s head, he would win freedom for them both. When Tell was successful, stunning and embarrassing the Austrian authorities, he was betrayed and arrested once more, leading to a popular uprising against the Austrians and uniting the disparate cantons of Switzerland into a single confederacy. The dial depicts three elements of the Tell legend. At the center of the dial, the apple represents not only the literal fruit from the Tell story, but also The Big Apple — New York City — home to both Massena LAB and Swiss Institute. The arrows, piercing the apple, function as the dial’s hour markers while also symbolizing precision, forward-movement, and progress. The bounds of ribbon, the loose blindfold of Tell’s rescued son, are a symbol of freedom, liberation, and the opposite of blindness: vision, wisdom, and knowledge. Generously donated by UNIMATIC and Massena LAB, the watch is being sold to benefit the missions of Swiss Institute. The buyer of this lot may be eligible to receive a charitable tax deduction for their purchase. specsRaw.Countdown Bezel: Marked in reverse, from 60 down to 0, this bezel is designed for timing a set interval. Rotate it so the desired number of minutes (for example, 15) lines up with the minute hand. When the minute hand reaches the 0 marker, the countdown is complete.
specsRaw.GMT Bezel: Featuring a 24-hour scale, the GMT bezel rotates in both directions and works together with your watch's GMT hand to display a second time zone. By adjusting the bezel, you can also track a third time zone.
specsRaw.Compass Bezel: Marked with the cardinal directions, the compass bezel can be used for basic navigation. Point the hour hand toward the sun, then use the bezel's directional markings to determine north and south.
specsRaw.Dive / Elapsed Time Bezel: Marked from 0 to 60 minutes, this bezel rotates only counter-clockwise. Align the triangle (0 marker) with the current position of the minute hand to track the elapsed time at a glance.

The 2.5 mm thick double domed anti-reflective sapphire crystal provides the best performance in every light condition. The solid 316 stainless steel case with a brushed finish, the screwed-in 2 mm thick caseback, the 8 mm diameter crown coupled with fat 5.5 mm screw-in pushers, together with the high quality gaskets set provide a water resistance tested individually to 30atm=300m=1000ft. Timing accuracy is guaranteed by the VK64 meca-quartz movement tuned to 32,768 Hz for 3 years battery life, with 1/5 of a second indication plus 60 minutes counter. The caseback features the UNIMATIC x Highsnobiety x Disney Year 1929 crew-down caseback engraving and the individual progressive number. The watch is covered by a 24 months worldwide warranty and is part of a unique edition of 100 pieces.

specsRaw.Countdown Bezel: Marked in reverse, from 60 down to 0, this bezel is designed for timing a set interval. Rotate it so the desired number of minutes (for example, 15) lines up with the minute hand. When the minute hand reaches the 0 marker, the countdown is complete.
specsRaw.GMT Bezel: Featuring a 24-hour scale, the GMT bezel rotates in both directions and works together with your watch's GMT hand to display a second time zone. By adjusting the bezel, you can also track a third time zone.
specsRaw.Compass Bezel: Marked with the cardinal directions, the compass bezel can be used for basic navigation. Point the hour hand toward the sun, then use the bezel's directional markings to determine north and south.
specsRaw.Dive / Elapsed Time Bezel: Marked from 0 to 60 minutes, this bezel rotates only counter-clockwise. Align the triangle (0 marker) with the current position of the minute hand to track the elapsed time at a glance.

specsRaw.Countdown Bezel: Marked in reverse, from 60 down to 0, this bezel is designed for timing a set interval. Rotate it so the desired number of minutes (for example, 15) lines up with the minute hand. When the minute hand reaches the 0 marker, the countdown is complete.
specsRaw.GMT Bezel: Featuring a 24-hour scale, the GMT bezel rotates in both directions and works together with your watch's GMT hand to display a second time zone. By adjusting the bezel, you can also track a third time zone.
specsRaw.Compass Bezel: Marked with the cardinal directions, the compass bezel can be used for basic navigation. Point the hour hand toward the sun, then use the bezel's directional markings to determine north and south.

watches.name: Modello Uno U1-ML6
watches.description: Modello Uno ref. U1-ML6 Unimatic x Massena Lab Housed inside the 40mm stainless steel case of the U1-ML6 is the automatic caliber Seiko NH35A 21600bph, with a power reserve of 41 hours. The watch features a classic black bezel with a red triangle dot market, reminiscent of the Rolex 6538, made famous by Sean Connery as James Bond in Goldfinger. The 15 minute marker on the bezel is the first time that UNIMATIC has featured it on one of its watches. Turning the 120-click unidirectional bezel is both an audible and tactile treat; the bezel hangs slightly over the diameter of the watch, making it easier to turn as well. In order to achieve its unique patina dial, each one of the U1-ML6 dial’s went through a galvanisation process, fading from the original black color to its tropical, warm brown hue. As each dial reacts differently to the process, no two are exactly alike - creating a truly unique watch. In addition, the Super-LumiNova is applied on each dial by hand, hands, and markers - making for an entirely hand-made “fatto a mano” dial. Turning the watch over, the viewer is treated to a detailed engraving of the Greek god, Poseidon. Aside from the reference to the god of the sea, the engraving pays tribute to World War II hero and veteran Alastair Robertson, an officer in the British Royal Navy. Before his retirement, he served as the navigator for the aircraft carrier HMS Ocean, the ship’s crest was that of Poseidon. Fitted with a Horween Shell Cordovan Color 8 strap, the UNIMATIC x Massena LAB U1-ML6 comes with a black, heavy-duty UNIMATIC nylon nato strap for added versatility. It features a matte black heritage diver aluminium insert with raised lume dot matching with Super-LumiNova® GL light old radium on the vintage navy dial. Time is displayed thanks to the matte black ladder phantom hands set and the reverse lollipop second hand with matte white tip. The double domed anti-reflective sapphire crystal provides the best performance in every light condition. The solid 316 brushed stainless steel case, the screwed-in 2mm thick caseback, the 8mm diameter crown together with the high quality gaskets set provide a water resistance tested individually to 30 atm=300m=1000ft. Timing accuracy is guaranteed by the NH35A automatic movement tuned to, 21600bph with 41h power reserve and hacking seconds hand. It comes on a vintage navy vintage navy tapered quick-release two-piece TPU strap with stainless steel brushed hardware signed UNIMATIC. The Diving Heritage screw-down caseback features the individual progressive number. The watch is covered by a 24-month worldwide warranty and is part of a unique edition of 300 pieces. watches.name: Steel Sandblasted Bracelet
